How buying works

Questions

Everything you need to know before you buy.

When do I get my items?

Right after you pay, as long as you're online. If you're offline, they show up the next time you join.

Does it work on Bedrock?

Yes. Pick Bedrock in the cart and type your Xbox gamertag. Everything works the same on Java and Bedrock.

How do I switch my tag or name color?

Type /tags in game. You can switch between anything you own at any time.

Is anything a subscription?

No. Every item is a one-time payment and you keep it forever.

I typed the wrong name. What now?

Open a ticket in our Discord with your receipt and we'll move it to the right name.

What do donations do?

They pay for the server. Donations don't give items, but you'll get a thank-you in chat.
